subject: Scheduling: ICM security review for Redwood integration
messages:
From: Kyle Harper <kyle.harper@icm-systems.com>
To: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@icm-systems.com
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security review for Redwood inference integration

Hi Monica / Ben,

Thanks again for the product overview yesterday. Our security and procurement teams would like to run a formal security review before we move to a pilot. Can we schedule a joint session with Redwood security, an AE or SE, and our engineering lead (Samantha)?

Preferred goals for the meeting:
- Walk through data flows and isolation model
- Review SOC2 scope and any logs/audit capabilities
- Understand certs/KMS options and retention rules

Availability from our side (PDT): next week available windows are
- Tue 2026-09-08: 09:00-11:00 or 15:00-17:00
- Wed 2026-09-09: 11:00-14:00

I attached our vendor questionnaire (icm_vendor_questionnaire.docx) to help the prep. Please let me know who from Redwood should join and what prep we should provide.

Thanks,
Kyle Harper
Head of Integrations | ICM Systems
From: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kyle Harper <kyle.harper@icm-systems.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, david_kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security review for Redwood inference integration

Hi Kyle — great to connect.

Thanks for sending the questionnaire. We typically run a 60-minute security deep-dive with our security/compliance engineer plus an SE to cover architecture and integration specifics. For efficiency we also send a short prep checklist up front. I attached our 15-minute checklist to outline what we need beforehand.

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Mon 2026-09-07 10:00-11:00
- Thu 2026-09-10 13:00-14:00
- Fri 2026-09-11 09:00-10:00

@Kimberly / @David — can you confirm availability for a 60-minute kickoff sometime next week? We should also confirm whether procurement/legal will join the first call or just observe.

Kyle — if you can share Samantha's calendar and a point contact for procurement I will lock this in.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, david_kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Kyle Harper <kyle.harper@icm-systems.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security review for Redwood inference integration

Thanks Monica / Kyle — Kimberly from Security here. A couple quick notes from the security side:

- We prefer a 60-minute technical deep dive (architecture, auth/KMS, network paths, data residency). 30 minutes is usually too short for items that come up.
- Please provide a network diagram and the vendor questionnaire filled where possible prior to the call. Also useful: a short list of integration endpoints and whether you expect user data or only metadata to be sent to Redwood.

Suggested availability (PDT):
- Wed 2026-09-09 11:00-12:00
- Thu 2026-09-10 13:00-14:00
- Fri 2026-09-11 09:00-10:00

I've attached a prep template that shows the fields we typically ask for. If procurement/legal plan to raise contractual items, we can have a follow-up with our contracts lead, but for the first session we aim to keep it technical.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

--
Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Kyle Harper <kyle.harper@icm-systems.com>
To: kimberly.park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@icm-systems.com>, procurement@icm-systems.com
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security review for Redwood inference integration

Hi Kimberly / Monica — thanks for the quick responses.

Samantha can join and has availability on Wed 2026-09-09 11:00-12:00 PDT — that matches one of your suggested slots. Procurement (procurement@icm-systems.com) will join briefly to confirm timelines but won’t lead the technical discussion.

I'll fill out the vendor questionnaire and upload the network diagram you requested to the shared folder by EOD Monday.

Please go ahead and send a calendar invite for Wed 2026-09-09 11:00 PDT (60 minutes) with a short agenda.

Best,
Kyle
From: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kyle Harper <kyle.harper@icm-systems.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, david_kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@icm-systems.com
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security review for Redwood inference integration — calendar invite and agenda

Great — confirmed for:

Wed 9 Sep 2026 11:00 AM - 12:00 PM PDT (60 minutes)
Conference: Google Meet (link below)
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=icm-redwood-0903
Shared prep folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/ICM-Redwood-Security

Prelim agenda (please flag/add items):
1) Introductions and scope (5m)
2) Architecture overview and data flows (20m) — David Kim (Redwood SE) + Samantha (ICM)
3) Auth, KMS, and certificate management (15m) — Kimberly Park (Redwood Sec)
4) Logging/audit and retention options (10m)
5) Next steps and procurement touchpoints (10m)

Attachments included: agenda-sec-review-icm-0903.pdf
Requested from ICM prior to the call:
- Filled vendor questionnaire (icm_vendor_questionnaire.docx)
- Network diagram (PDF or Visio)
- Any SOC2 excerpts you can share

If that all looks good I'll send the invite. Thanks everyone — see you on Wednesday.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Office: +1 (415) 555-0124
